tables.name: bundle_definitions
tables.purpose: Master record for each merchant-created bundle, its configuration, and its current health status.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: bundle_type
columns.purpose: fixed or flexible

columns.name: flexible_pick_count
columns.purpose: number of items the customer must pick for flexible bundles

columns.name: discount_kind
columns.purpose: percentage, flat-amount, or buy-x-get-y

columns.name: health_status
columns.purpose: ok or degraded — set to degraded when a component product/variant is deleted or disabled

columns.name: shopify_bundle_product_external_id
columns.purpose: the Shopify product bundle resource created for this definition

columns.name: purchase_count
columns.purpose: pre-aggregated count of confirmed paid orders attributing this bundle

tables.name: bundle_components
tables.purpose: The individual product or variant slots that make up a bundle definition.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundle_definitions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: parent bundle definition

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: the source product for this slot

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: specific variant when the merchant pins to a variant; null means any variant of the product

columns.name: position
columns.purpose: display order within the bundle

tables.name: bundle_discount_tiers
tables.purpose: Configurable discount tiers per bundle, each mapped to a Shopify discount code.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundle_definitions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: parent bundle definition

columns.name: min_item_count
columns.purpose: minimum number of items in the bundle for this tier to activate

columns.name: discount_value
columns.purpose: fractional rate for percentage-off tiers stored as integer basis points (e.g. 2000 = 20%)

columns.name: discount_amount
columns.purpose: flat currency amount off for flat-amount tiers in minor units

columns.name: free_item_count
columns.purpose: number of items that are free for buy-x-get-y tiers

columns.name: discount_code
columns.purpose: the unique Shopify discount code string for this tier

columns.name: discount_external_id
columns.purpose: the Shopify discount node id for this tier's code

tables.name: bundle_purchase_attributions
tables.purpose: Records each confirmed paid order that used a bundle discount code, linking the order to the exact bundle and tier that triggered.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: order_external_id
columns.purpose: the paid order that used the bundle discount

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.purpose: the bundle definition that was purchased

columns.name: tier_id
columns.purpose: the specific tier that was applied

columns.name: discount_code
columns.purpose: the discount code string that was redeemed

columns.name: order_total
columns.purpose: order total in minor units

columns.name: currency
columns.purpose: currency code for order_total

admin.purpose: Return a paginated list of all bundle definitions with summary fields for the admin dashboard table.
Create a new bundle definition including its component items, discount type, and tiers.
Edit any field on an existing bundle definition and re-sync discount codes in Shopify.
Enable or disable one or more bundles in bulk.
Fetch the full definition of a single bundle for the edit form.

widget.purpose: Return all enabled bundle definitions that include a given product external id, used by the storefront widget on page load.
Add all selected bundle items to the Shopify cart and apply the matching tier discount code in one atomic action.
Compute and return the live discounted total for a customer's current bundle selection without modifying the cart.
